name: RDK X3 Module
summary: RDK X3 Module is a compact compute module for embedded robot products and custom carrier designs. It integrates a Sunrise 3 AI processor, a quad-core Cortex-A53 CPU and up to 5 TOPS of AI processing in a 55 × 40 mm form factor compatible with Raspberry Pi CM4. D-Robotics offers memory, eMMC and wireless configurations. Native camera, display, USB, Ethernet and GPIO resources are exposed through the module interface; external connectors depend on the carrier board.
